intent.proves: At least one active product has two non-image assets in the same asset category, each restricted to a different language, with different files.
intent.scope: active products of the declared product scope, every language; complete SQL enumeration

bindings.reason: get_product_images reads one product at a time; no complete host enumeration of details.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.DetailProductId) FROM EcomDetails a JOIN EcomDetails b ON b.DetailProductId = a.DetailProductId AND ISNULL(b.DetailVariantId, N'') = ISNULL(a.DetailVariantId, N'') AND b.DetailsGroupId = a.DetailsGroupId AND ISNULL(b.DetailLanguageId, N'') <> N'' AND b.DetailLanguageId <> a.DetailLanguageId AND b.DetailValue <> a.DetailValue WHERE a.DetailType = 0 AND ISNULL(a.DetailLanguageId, N'') <> N'' AND NOT (LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.jpg' OR LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.jpeg' OR LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.png' OR LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.gif' OR LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.webp' OR LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.avif' OR LOWER(a.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.svg') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductId = a.DetailProductId AND p.ProductActive = 1{inScope})

sources.ref: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS on a 10.29.8 install (read-only): dbo.EcomDetails.DetailLanguageId, DetailsGroupId
